name: TechNova College Tech Fest
brief: Organise TechNova, a two-day college tech fest for about 1,500 students. It has a 24-hour hackathon, a robotics competition, three workshops and an evening concert. We need sponsors, venue and permissions, social media marketing, online registrations, stage, sound and lighting, food stalls, volunteers and security, and post-event accounts. Organising team of about eleven students; the fest should happen before the end-semester break, about nine weeks out.

tasks.name: Define fest scope, events and budget

risks.title: Sponsors commit late
risks.cause: Companies finalise CSR and marketing budgets late in the quarter
risks.event: Main sponsors confirm weeks after outreach starts
risks.effect: Fund release and every vendor booking that waits on it slip
risks.response: Approach alumni-run companies first and agree a minimum confirmed budget before vendor bookings

risks.title: Venue permission delayed
risks.cause: The auditorium and grounds need sign-off from the dean and campus security
risks.event: Permission comes back late or with conditions
risks.effect: Venue-dependent bookings and security planning start late
risks.response: Submit the permission request in week 1 with a fallback venue named

risks.title: Slow fund release
risks.cause: College accounts need two signatures and a purchase order for each advance
risks.event: Advance payments to vendors are released late
risks.effect: Arena, stage and food vendors cannot be confirmed on time
risks.response: Pre-file purchase orders for the three largest vendors as soon as the budget is approved

risks.title: Robotics arena fails testing
risks.cause: The arena uses new sensors and a custom scoring system
risks.event: Sensors or scoring misbehave in the test run
risks.effect: The arena needs rework before the competition
risks.response: Build and test the scoring rig first and keep manual scoring as a fallback

risks.title: Payment gateway onboarding stalls
risks.cause: The gateway needs KYC documents from the college
risks.event: Online payments are not live when registrations open
risks.response: Use the college's existing fee-payment gateway account instead of a new one

risks.title: Volunteers drop out before exams
risks.cause: Volunteer training overlaps with internal assessments
risks.event: A third of the volunteers withdraw
risks.effect: Recruitment and training must be repeated
risks.response: Recruit 20% more volunteers than needed and run two short training slots

risks.title: Sound vendor backs out
risks.cause: A wedding-season booking pays the vendor more
risks.event: The stage and sound vendor cancels
risks.effect: A replacement vendor must be found and contracted
risks.response: Sign a contract with a cancellation penalty and keep a second quote on file

risks.title: Extra events added late
risks.cause: Clubs ask to add competitions after the programme is drafted
risks.event: New events are added to the hackathon and workshop tracks
risks.response: Freeze the event list at committee sign-off and route new ideas to next year

risks.title: Rehearsal exposes run-sheet gaps
risks.cause: Several committees hand over at the stage and gates
risks.event: The rehearsal shows unclear handovers and timing clashes
risks.effect: The run sheet needs a second rehearsal
risks.response: Hold a table-top walkthrough with every committee lead a week before the rehearsal
